weapons.name: Broadside Battery
weapons.desc: Four guns on one trigger. Very pyrate, very loud.

weapons.name: Chain Shot
weapons.desc: Two warheads on a chain. Tears through hull and machinery alike.

weapons.name: Grapple Bomb
weapons.desc: Lands with a clang and knocks everyone in the room off their feet.

augments.name: Jolly Roger Flag
augments.desc: Enemies hand over more loot: 15% more scrap, and your crew fight 5% harder.

ships.name: The Black Gull
ships.desc: A stolen pyrate brig. Big guns, a teleporter and a crew that asks no questions.

ships.name: The Gilded Debt
ships.desc: A smuggler's galleon. Chain shot, grapple bombs and a hold full of somebody else's scrap.

sectors.name: The Pyrate King's Court
sectors.blurb: The richest pyrates in the galaxy, and the King who taxes them all. Bring scrap, or bring guns.
intro: Gold-plated warships everywhere. The King's court is in session.
The Pyrate King's Court. Keep one hand on your scrap and the other on the trigger.

events.text: "This beacon is a toll bridge, by order of the Pyrate King. Thirty scrap, or we take it out of your hull."

effect.text: "Pleasure doing business." They wave you through.

choices.text: {who} challenges their captain to a duel.

success.text: {who} wins in under a minute. The pyrates pay YOU the toll and leave.

fail.text: {who} loses on a technicality. The pyrates charge their guns.

events.text: The pyrate captain lowers her guns a fraction. "Parley? You look like someone who can be reasoned with. Or robbed. One of the two."

success.text: She trades rumours for rumours and leaves you a chart of the sector.

fail.text: "Parley" turns out to mean "keep you talking while we aim".

events.text: The Pyrate King is crowning his heir today, and every ship in the sector has been "invited". Fireworks, music and a lot of guns are pointed at the throne room.

effect.text: The King is delighted and gives you a flag that tells every pyrate you are a friend of the crown.
The heir's escort comes out to meet you.

afterWin.text: In the chaos you make off with the party's prize table.

choices.text: Enjoy the fireworks from a safe distance.

effect.text: Lovely display. Only two ships exploded, and one was on purpose.

events.text: A one-eyed Sloog in a battered shuttle is selling a treasure map. "Genuine. Probably. The X is real, anyway."

effect.text: The X marks a beacon in this sector.

success.text: The Sloog sighs and hands it over for a sandwich.

fail.text: "No sandwich is worth this map." He flies off in a huff.

effect.text: He tries to sell you a second map on your way out.

events.text: The X on the map. A hollow asteroid with a door shaped like a skull, and fresh scorch marks: someone else got here first, or is still inside.

effect.text: A pyrate crew is halfway through the loot and very upset to see you.

afterWin.text: The treasure is real: piles of scrap and a fine old missile launcher.

effect.text: {who} comes back with the treasure and a few new scars.

events.text: A pyrate ship flashes an emergency signal. Its crew are mutinying against a cruel captain, and both sides are asking for your help.

effect.text: The captain's loyalists turn their guns on you.

afterWin.text: The new captain thanks you, and one of the mutineers asks to come with you.

effect.text: The mutiny collapses when your guns come online. The captain pays well and asks no questions.
The argument is still going when you jump.

events.text: A pyrate tax collector in a tiny gold-plated ship floats up with a clipboard. "The King's tax. Ten percent of everything. I'll need to see receipts."

effect.text: He gives you a receipt. It says you are now a friend of the King, which is worth something round here.
No clipboard, no tax. The collector flees in tears. He dropped his purse.
